title: Migration attribute collection requirements for VMware, AHV and OpenStack
freshness_policy: max_age_seconds from observation timestamp at plan evaluation and native-effect boundary, revoked upon any source identity/version/configuration/policy change even before TTL

collection_methods.native_get: Read authenticated allowlisted native API object with exact enrolled scope and response identity
collection_methods.native_list: Read all pages of scoped native list and fail on incomplete/ambiguous paging
collection_methods.derive: Derive from verified native fields; preserve canonical raw response checksum
collection_methods.operator: Record attributed operator assertion as owner evidence; never pretend a vendor API emitted it
collection_methods.probe: Authorized create/read/cleanup against exact version, followed by independent native qualification
collection_methods.independent: Independent measured operating or security check with reviewer evidence
